Technical Datasheet
RTP 36 rotary tablet press (single-sided)
Manufacturer Pressora Maschinenbau GmbH Document no. DS-TP201
Model RTP 36 Revision 0
Machine serial no. RTP36-25-0417 Issue date 08-Nov-2025
Customer PT Arunika Farma Lestari Customer equipment tag TP-201
Performance
Number of punch stations 36 stations
Turret speed 20–70 rpm
Maximum output 151,200 tablets/h
Maximum main compression force 100 kN
Maximum pre-compression force 20 kN
Tooling
Maximum tablet diameter 25 mm
Maximum fill depth 18 mm
Tooling standard EU B
Materials and finish SS 316L
Product-contact parts
Surface roughness Ra, product-contact parts (max.) 0.8 µm
Frame and covers SS 304
Control and safety
Automatic tablet weight control (force-based) Yes
Automatic rejection of out-of-limit tablets Yes
Compression force measurement accuracy (max. ±) 1 % FS
Feeder paddle speed 10–60 rpm
Emergency stop Yes
Punch overload protection Yes
Design values for machine serial no. RTP36-25-0417, as built for the customer's order. Values marked max. are limits of the machine.
Prepared by Markus Brandt Signed electronically 08-Nov-2025
HMI and data
User access levels (operator, supervisor, admin) Yes
Audit trail of parameter and recipe changes Yes
Alarm log with time and user Yes
Utilities
Power supply (3 phase, 50 Hz) 380 V
Compressed air 6–7 bar
Dust extraction flow (required) 300 m3/h
